ideas.title: Weekly home cleaning rounds (north)
ideas.one_liner: Busy households pay for a fixed weekly or fortnightly clean of kitchens, bathrooms and floors.
steps: Flyer 30 homes in one suburb this weekend
Offer a discounted first clean
Buy supplies from the local supermarket
Book two homes per day, back to back
Photograph one before/after with permission
Ask every client for a Google review
Raise rates after ten regular clients
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Never quote without seeing the rooms
Ask about allergies before using products
Get insurance before touching client property
ideas.compliance_note: US: check local business-name registration and sales-tax rules.
